title: GEPA sidecar JSON-RPC 2.0 messages (T12, T09 §4.3 / ADR-009)
description: Schema-validated JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio between the Node/TS runner (trust anchor) and the Python sidecar (compute worker). Request/response only — the sidecar never initiates actions (ADR-009 §6.3.1). Every message validates against this schema on both sides; a message that fails validation is an error, never silently accepted.
